GUARDRAILS: design is an INFERENCE, contested — never 'science proves God'; fine-tuning DATA conceded/DESIGN inferred; do NOT present intelligent-design or old-earth cosmology as settled Christian doctrine (denominationally divisive); kalam-adjacent = 'whatever begins', not 'everything has a cause'. voiceover: Does modern science point away from God, or toward him? Here is what this section explores. The evidence that the universe had a beginning, and the question of a cause. The fine-tuning of the laws and constants for life, and the debate over what it means. The origin of life, the sudden burst of the Cambrian, and the strange reach of mathematics. And whether miracles are even possible — the question the section takes on. Every one of these arguments gets a fully-cited deep-dive essay. Each claim is sourced, and the strongest objections are stated fairly, then answered. That is our standard — Checked Before Published. And you will not just read. On every essay an AI tutor answers your questions — ask it anything, or highlight a single sentence and ask about that exact line. Mastery mode lets you explain the argument back in your own words and have it graded. Daily practice brings the key points back just as you are about to forget them. There are pocket cards to share, and a Debate Arena to practise against an AI sceptic before the real conversation. Every essay comes in a plain-English version and a full deep dive, with read-aloud audio. Design is an inference, not a laboratory result, and honest people still disagree. What this section makes the case for is that the universe looks more like the work of a mind than an accident — a pointer worth following. Start anywhere, and follow it where it leads.
